title: Labor Code, Division 2, Part 1 (Compensation) - final pay on discharge or quitting
verified_how: Fetched LAB §201: current, amended by Stats. 2018, Ch. 903 (SB 1504). The Part 1 range comes from the Div 2 expanded branch.
notes: Wages due on discharge (§201), on quitting (§202), and waiting-time penalties (§203). California has no statutory severance pay.
